name: Docker Swarm
description: Shows a Docker Swarm cluster: every node as a host (role, availability, state, address) and every task (a running copy of a service) as a guest of the node it runs on, with service name, stack, image, published ports and state. Read-only through a socket proxy on one manager node. Use the Docker plugin as well if you also want the plain containers and their health.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
